captions.detailed: This 3D model is a hemispherical back-shell component designed for a custom lithophane ornament. It features a smooth, domed outer surface with a uniform shell thickness, leaving the bottom open to attach to a circular frame. A specialized keyhole-shaped cutout is positioned on one side of the dome, consisting of a central circular hole flanked by two smaller slotted ears, designed to securely mount a standard holiday light bulb for illumination.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric hemispherical back cover for a circular lithophane ornament in OpenSCAD. The script should allow the user to adjust the outer diameter, shell thickness, and include a custom-shaped mounting hole on the back of the dome designed to fit a holiday light string bulb.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a union of three main sections. First, a flat lithophane surface is generated using the surface() function, scaled and trimmed to a circular shape using difference() with cylinders. Second, a thin cylindrical frame wall is created using a difference of two cylinders. Third, a hollow hemispherical dome is built using a difference of two concentric spheres, trimmed flat at the bottom using a cylinder, and detailed with a light-bulb mounting hole created by subtracting a rotated union of a central cylinder and two hull() generated side slots.
